notes: Idris Quillon, the unlicensed teacher (bible 5.17). Dot tells it after the hearth is lit, in dot-sleeping-ox.
text: If you want to learn the old fire tricks, don't ask the college. Walk down to the water after dark, past the Watch. Somebody under the bridge keeps a lantern lit and takes coin. I never said so.

followUp.text: You found the man under the bridge. I never said a thing. Keep that lantern lit.
